flows.title: Add, rename or reorder pipeline stages
steps: Open the pipeline, click … in the top menu and choose Edit pipeline. This needs admin access in Kommo.
To add a stage, click Add stage and enter the stage's name.
To rename a stage, click its name and edit it. Incoming leads cannot be renamed; Closed-Won and Closed-Lost can be renamed but not moved or deleted.
To change the order, hover over the grip icon (six dots) on the left of a stage and, when the hand icon appears, drag the stage to its new position.

flows.title: Change several leads at once
steps: In the board view, click the three dots button in the upper right corner and choose Select multiple. In the list view — the triple bar icon next to the Search bar — the checkboxes are already on the left.
Tick the checkboxes of the leads you want to change.
Choose one of the bulk actions above the board or the list, such as changing the responsible user, adding tasks, changing the stage or editing tags.
